summary: On an azure (8) background with exactly one full-width red (2) row (the line), every 4-connected color-1 shape above the line falls downward. A thin shape (every row holds a single cell, i.e. a vertical bar or singleton) falls through the line until its lowest cell lands on the grid's last row and punches an 8-hole in the line at each of its columns. A wide shape (some row holds >=2 cells) falls until its lowest wide row rests on the row just above the line; any thin tail below that wide row overwrites line cells and can extend below the line. Original shape cells above the line are erased to the 8 background.
